QuestInfo.name: [The Afterlands] A World Devoid of Color
QuestInfo.0: The Land of Contemplation seems to be a nearly empty expanse. Everything there looks to be devoid of color, even the people.\r\n\r\nThe people who live in the Land of Contemplation seem to think it's normal to have no color. You should find something with color and show them what they're missing!
